headline: Almost high tide
sub: Water is rising for about 20 more minutes

current.title: Flowing east
current.text: As the tide rises, sea water rushes through the pass toward the Strait.

explainer.title: The Moon pulls on the sea
explainer.text: Its gravity tugs the ocean into a bulge. As Earth spins, we pass through it, so the water rises and falls about twice a day.
